papers.title_en: RLPE: Teaching LLMs to Prompt with Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Rahul Singhal, Karime Maamari, Pradyumna Tambwekar
papers.evidence: 使用强化学习进行自动提示工程与优化
papers.tldr: 本文介绍了强化学习提示词工程（RLPE）方法，通过训练一个模型来分析任务模型的执行轨迹并编写针对性的提示词。RLPE根据提示词性能直接给予奖励，生成的提示词可复用且兼容闭源模型。实验表明，训练出的9B参数模型在多个基准测试中表现优于顶尖前沿模型和现有优化器，具备优秀的泛化与迭代能力。
papers.abstract_en: Prompting is a widely used method for adapting general-purpose LLMs to domain-specific tasks. Effective prompts can be tedious to create manually, so prompt writing is increasingly handed to LLMs, with recent work training LLMs to write prompts for other models. These techniques either write prompts without observing how the task model behaves, blind to the failure modes the prompt should address, or must run alongside the task LLM at inference time, adding overhead to every query. Neither reflects how prompt engineering is often practiced. To close this gap, we introduce Reinforcement Learned Prompt Engineering (RLPE), which trains a model to analyze traces of a separate task model and write a prompt targeting the failures it observes. RLPE rewards the trained model strictly on prompt performance, so it learns the prompting strategies that improve the task model. The prompt is generated once and reused across the task, so inference does not require the trained model. Since RLPE needs only query access to the model it prompts, it is also compatible with closed-source models. We apply RLPE to Enigmata, BIG-Bench Extra Hard, and PlanBench. We train a 9B-parameter model that writes better prompts than state-of-the-art frontier models (gpt-5.6-sol and claude-opus-5) and prompt optimizers (GEPA and TextGrad) on 2/3 benchmarks. Although the model is never explicitly trained to iterate on prompts, this capability emerges at a level that matches or beats frontier models. The learned prompting capability also generalizes, with the trained model improving task models 6x larger than the one it trained with, including ones from entirely different model families, and matching claude-opus-5 on a fourth benchmark held out from training.

papers.title_en: Beyond Aggregate Accuracy: Item-Level Transitions in Prompt Optimization
papers.evidence: 利用模型响应反馈进行自动提示优化
papers.tldr: 本研究指出自动提示词优化（APO）通常仅用总体准确率评估，忽视了题目级别的动态变化。为此，作者提出了反射式反馈驱动的提示词优化（RFDPO）方法，通过追踪恢复、退化和波动等条目级状态来指导优化。研究表明，总体准确率掩盖了显著的答案变动，而基于条目级反馈的RFDPO在保持净收益的同时大幅减少了波动，凸显了在未见数据上报告细粒度指标的重要性。
papers.abstract_en: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) uses feedback from model responses to improve prompts automatically. However, its effectiveness is usually measured through overall scores, which do not reveal which questions become correct, which previously correct answers become wrong, or whether improvements extend to unseen questions. We introduce Reflective Feedback-Driven Prompt Optimization (RFDPO), a tool that tracks recoveries (incorrect to correct), regressions (correct to incorrect), and churn (all changed outcomes). RFDPO uses this feedback to guide subsequent revisions and records prompt changes throughout optimization. We evaluate RFDPO across five benchmarks covering law, knowledge, instruction following, mathematics, and privacy, using GPT-5 as the optimizer and GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4.1 Mini as solvers. Our results show that overall accuracy can hide substantial changes: in five of nine configurations, churn was at least five times the absolute net change, and a single-item net change concealed up to 17 changed outcomes. Average validation gains were 7.9 percentage points, compared with 5.2 points on held-out tests. In a controlled ablation on LegalBench-Hearsay, item-level feedback reduced churn by 40% ($p=0.024$) while maintaining similar net gains. These findings motivate reporting recovery, regression, churn, and performance on unseen data alongside overall accuracy.

papers.title_en: HERO: Harnessing Evidence for Test-time Refinement and Prompt Optimization in Program Generation
papers.authors: Mingyu Lu, Timothy Ossowski, Tristan Naumann, Hoifung Poon, Peniel Argaw
papers.evidence: 程序生成的自动化提示优化
papers.tldr: 该论文提出HERO框架，用于解决大语言模型在程序生成中的提示词优化和代码精炼问题。针对现有方法易破坏已有正确行为的缺陷，HERO利用代码执行反馈，结合离线提示优化与测试时精炼，在多个基准测试中显著提升了代码生成的准确率和执行效率。
papers.abstract_en: Harness optimization improves LLMs by refining reusable prompts and scaffolding, yet requires further adaptation for program generation tasks such as text-to-SQL and text-to-Python. Existing methods often rely on LLM reflectors to propose harness updates, which can fix observed failures but also disrupt previously correct behavior. Text-to-code tasks offer a natural way to mitigate this issue: we can execute generated outputs, allowing us to evaluate and verify the effects of proposed updates directly. Building on this signal, we introduce \textsc{HERO} (\textbf{H}arnessing \textbf{E}vidence for \textbf{R}efinement and \textbf{O}ptimization), which combines offline and test-time harness optimization. At the first stage, \method{} learns reusable prompt updates from execution-verified successes and failures and validates candidate revisions before adoption. At test time, we treat the generated code as an instance-specific harness and refine it using execution feedback. Across four SQL, Cypher, and Python benchmarks, \method{} achieves the best offline performance, improving pass@1 by \(7.6\) points over the initial prompt, while test-time refinement adds another \(2.0\) points and improves execution efficiency.

papers.title_en: Designing Textual Interfaces To Enhance Llm Reasoning On Audio-Visual Question Answering
papers.authors: Yi Wang, Tianzi Wang, Tong Lei, Dahan Wang, Peter Bell
papers.evidence: 多模态推理的自动提示词优化
papers.tldr: 该论文探讨了文本界面设计如何影响音频-视觉问答任务中大语言模型的提示词优化。研究比较了全模态大模型直接推理、图像描述-推理系统以及主从代理架构这三种文本界面，发现直接提示优化带来模型相关的收益，而多模态系统虽然优化接口更具可解释性但更难优化，凸显了文本界面设计对全模态推理系统提示优化的重要性。
papers.abstract_en: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has shown strong effectiveness for text-based LLMs and LLM systems, but its application to audio-visual understanding systems requires suitable textual interfaces through which multimodal reasoning can be exposed to text-based optimizers. We investigate how the design of textual interfaces affects prompt optimization for multimodal reasoning, on the audio-visual question answering task. We compare three interface designs, including a direct inference system consisting of a single omni-modal large language model (OmniLLM), a captioner-reasoner system, and an agentic architecture in which a primary agent orchestrates subagent OmniLLMs. Experiments with Qwen3-Omni and Gemini show that direct prompt optimization provides model-dependent gains; the captioner-reasoner system and the agentic system expose more interpretable optimization interfaces but are harder to optimize, where error analysis of cases affected by optimization is conducted. Our study highlights textual interface design as an important factor in making prompt optimization effective for omni-modal reasoning systems. Our implementation details are specified in GitHub repo.

papers.title_en: From Agents to Edges: Paired Optimization for Multi-Agent Collaboration
papers.authors: Feng Lin, Xiaotian Yu, Yifan Yang, Aijun Li
papers.evidence: 联合优化多智能体系统的指令和提示词
papers.tldr: 该论文研究了多智能体系统中强个体并不保证有效协作的问题，指出通信是关键优化单元。为此，作者提出了成对自动化通信优化（PACO）方法，在保持模型权重和工作流拓扑不变的前提下，联合优化通信边缘两端的指令与共享通信协议。PACO显著提升了多智能体协作性能，并在跨数据集迁移中展现出强大的泛化能力。
papers.abstract_en: Strong individual agents do not guarantee effective collaboration. Communication must align what one agent conveys with how another interprets and uses it. This dependency makes the communication edge a natural unit of optimization. We introduce Paired Automated Communication Optimization (PACO), which jointly optimizes the instructions at both ends of each edge and their shared communication convention in systems built on black-box language models. PACO keeps model weights, agent roles, and workflow topology fixed. A state-aware discounted bandit selects edges for refinement, while execution feedback guides paired revisions evaluated through staged end-to-end execution. The optimized instructions integrate into existing agent prompts without additional model calls at deployment. On a four-agent workflow evaluated across diverse multi-agent benchmarks, PACO consistently outperforms leading prompt-optimization and communication baselines. Configurations learned on HotpotQA retain their advantage in cross-dataset transfer without target-specific optimization. These results demonstrate that optimizing how agents communicate can substantially improve collaboration within an otherwise fixed system.

papers.title_en: FlowCred: Hierarchical Credit Assignment and Functional Coordination for Joint Text-to-Video Post-Training
papers.authors: Mingxuan Zhu, Yanwei Huang, Shiyuan Liu, Xinzhi Zhang, Shujie Li, Yuanxing Zhang, Lu Chen
papers.evidence: 联合优化提示策略和生成器
papers.tldr: 本文针对文本到视频（T2V）生成中联合优化提示词策略与视频 generator 时存在的信用分配模糊和功能冗余问题，提出了FlowCred两级框架。通过分层信用分配解耦提示词与生成器残差，并结合功能协调机制，实现了高效的联合后训练，在多个基准测试中显著提升了生成质量，且未增加计算开销。
papers.abstract_en: Prompt optimization and generator post-training are two complementary ways to improve text-to-video (T2V) generation, and recent systems increasingly train both modules jointly. However, optimizing a prompt policy and a video generator from the same terminal reward creates two ambiguities: prompt quality is confounded with stochastic generation, and the two modules may realize overlapping local improvements. We introduce FlowCred, a two-level framework for joint T2V post-training. First, hierarchical credit assignment uses matched prompt-seed rollout grids to separate prompt-level credit from prompt-conditioned generator residuals under shared randomness. Second, functional coordination probes alternative current-policy prompts at states from actual generation trajectories, providing generator-aware evidence for prompt optimization while selectively attenuating generator updates already supported by conditioning changes. Across multiple T2V benchmarks, FlowCred consistently improves matched joint-training baselines. On LTX-2.5, FlowCred improves a strictly matched joint-training control from 61.47 to 64.46 on T2V-CompBench and from 55.58 to 58.08 on StoryEval, without increasing decoded-video or reward-model-call budgets. Factorial and realized-update analyses show complementary contributions from prompt shaping and generator routing, while human evaluation and transfer across backbones and updater families provide further supporting evidence.

papers.title_en: Personalized Federated Direct Preference Optimization via LoRA Adapters
papers.evidence: 用于参数高效对齐的 LoRA 适配器
papers.tldr: 联邦直接偏好优化（FedDPO）在分布式代理间对齐语言模型时假设所有客户端收敛至单一策略，这与实际异构偏好相冲突。本文提出了个性化FedDPO（pFedDPO），每个客户端在共享全局基础模型之上维护一个私有LoRA适配器，以捕捉个性化偏好模式。
papers.abstract_en: Federated Direct Preference Optimization (FedDPO) enables privacy-preserving alignment of language models across distributed agents without centralizing sensitive preference data. However, existing FedDPO analysis assumes all clients converge to a single shared policy, which is fundamentally at odds with the heterogeneous preference distributions present in practice. We propose Personalized FedDPO (pFedDPO), in which each client maintains a small private LoRA adapter atop a shared global base model. In pFedDPO, the base model is synchronized via FedAvg each round, while LoRA adapters remain local and capture client-specific preference patterns. We prove that this decomposition replaces the gradient diversity $κ^2$ in the FedDPO bound with a residual heterogeneity $κ^2_{\mathrm{eff}}$, which is no larger than $κ^2$ when adapters absorb client-specific directions, at the cost of an additive adapter-bias term that vanishes as adapters converge. Experiments on preference datasets show that pFedDPO consistently attains a lower gradient norm than vanilla FedDPO while remaining competitive in training loss and per-client reward accuracy.

papers.title_en: Matching Full-Hessian Oracle Complexity for Nonconvex--Strongly-Concave Minimax Optimization
papers.authors: Fangqing Zhang, Haihan Zhang, Wendao Wu, Chenheng Zhang, Chunyuan Zheng, Cong Fang, Haoxuan Li, Zhouchen Lin
papers.evidence: 极大极小优化复杂度分析
papers.tldr: 该论文研究了非凸-强凹（NC-SC）极小极大优化问题在使用全Hessian预言机时的复杂度。通过建立确定性上界和随机下界，作者精确刻画了在不同精度和条件数下的最优预言机复杂度，揭示了其对精度、条件数和Hessian平滑度的非平凡依赖关系，并量化了相比传统一阶方法的性能提升。
papers.abstract_en: We characterize the oracle complexity of finding first-order stationary points in smooth nonconvex--strongly-concave (NC--SC) minimax optimization when each query provides the full Hessian in addition to the function value and gradient. For $Φ(x)=\max_y f(x,y)$, assume that $f$ has an $L$-Lipschitz gradient, a $ρ$-Lipschitz Hessian, and is $μ$-strongly concave in $y$. Let $κ=L/μ$, let $Δ$ denote the initial value gap, and define $r=ρκ^{3/2}\varepsilon/L^2$.   We establish matching deterministic upper bounds and randomized lower bounds, up to logarithmic factors and additive initialization costs. When the leading term dominates initialization, the resulting minimax complexity is \[ \widetildeΘ\!\left( \frac{ΔL}{\varepsilon^2}Ψ_κ(r) \right), \qquad Ψ_κ(r)= \begin{cases} r^{1/2}, & 0<r\le 1,\\ r^{2/7}, & 1<r<κ^{7/4},\\ \sqrtκ, & r\geκ^{7/4}. \end{cases} \] Despite the stronger oracle, the optimal complexity exhibits a nontrivial dependence on accuracy, conditioning, and Hessian smoothness. In particular, these regimes exhibit accuracy dependencies $\varepsilon^{-3/2}$, $\varepsilon^{-12/7}$, and $\varepsilon^{-2}$, respectively.   The upper bounds combine second-order regularity estimates for a saddle Moreau envelope with certified accelerated reduced-dual solves and amortized warm starts. The lower bounds combine an all-derivative lift with a serial composition of private-handle constructions, using hard instances chosen independently of the algorithm's realized random seed. The resulting characterization quantifies improvements over the classical first-order benchmark under gradient smoothness alone and identifies the regime in which that benchmark is recovered.

papers.title_en: EPOCH: Coverage-Aware Evolution with Experiential Preference Optimization for LLM-based Automated Heuristic Design
papers.authors: Oguzhan Gungordu, Ayse Tursucular, Siheng Xiong, Faramarz Fekri
papers.evidence: 基于大语言模型的进化搜索和反思提示词自动化启发式设计
papers.tldr: 该论文提出了EPOCH框架，用于大语言模型驱动的自动化启发式设计。传统方法忽略了实例覆盖率且无法将自然语言反馈内化到模型权重中。EPOCH通过将实例覆盖率作为演化搜索的目标，并利用体验偏好优化和反思性自蒸馏微调生成器，实现了互补启发式集成的高效发现。
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based automated heuristic design (AHD) discovers heuristics for combinatorial optimization problems (COPs), where an LLM generates candidates in an evolutionary search. Existing frameworks freeze the generator or fine-tune it on a scalar fitness signal hiding which instances each heuristic covers. Reflection-based frameworks improve heuristics with natural-language feedback, but it stays in the prompt and never reaches the generator's weights. We propose EPOCH, which makes instance coverage the objective of the evolutionary search and fine-tunes the generator to internalize reflection. Parent selection, operator allocation, and stagnation recovery all optimize how well the heuristics jointly cover the training instances, so the search returns a complementary heuristic ensemble. The generator learns from its own search by experiential preference optimization. A teacher LLM returns a natural-language insight on the generated heuristics, and the generator produces new heuristics with this insight. These improvements join the preference pairs for direct preference optimization (DPO). Since DPO only teaches the generator to rank these improvements, a reflective self-distillation (RSD) term makes it more likely to generate them on its own, and the gains accumulate over the long horizon of the search. Across COPs and open-source LLM backbones, EPOCH's heuristic ensembles outperform inference-only and fine-tuned baselines and generalize across problem scales.

papers.title_en: Gaussian Process Bandits for AI System Optimization with Selectively Verified Feedback
papers.evidence: 利用高斯过程多臂老虎机优化提示
papers.tldr: 本论文研究了在AI系统优化中结合高斯过程多臂老虎机与选择性验证反馈的问题。针对廉价模型评估与可信任务结果可能不一致的挑战，作者构建了结合可靠性覆盖与奖励分离的固定审计设计，并提出了安全自适应扩展算法，建立了有限时间遗憾边界，并通过实验评估了其在反馈校正和策略方面的表现。
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian process bandits exploit similarities among configurations to optimize prompts, retrieval systems, and agent workflows. In these applications, however, inexpensive model-based evaluations can disagree with trusted task outcomes. We study selective verification when an action is chosen before a diagnostic is observed and trusted feedback is informative on an unknown set of diagnostic states. A finite reliability class and a finite RKHS signal dictionary describe these two sources of uncertainty. We construct a fixed audit design that combines reliability coverage with reward separation and establish a finite-time regret bound that accounts for a hard audit budget and the rounds needed to obtain informative observations. A safe adaptive extension mixes this robust design with predictable Chernoff allocations while preserving a uniform identification floor and exact expected acquisition-cost accounting. For signed-coordinate kernels, structured and diffuse reliability classes require different audit scales despite sharing the same reward geometry. Synthetic experiments distinguish these certified designs from an adaptive posterior heuristic and GP controls. Safe adaptive allocation reduces aggregate regret relative to the fixed design under the exact dictionary, but its finite-budget error certificate is numerically loose. Conditional-feedback errors can remove the heuristic's advantage and target perturbations can reverse it. Separate AI-task replays assess feedback correction and fitted-dictionary policies without establishing end-to-end validation of a learned selective-verification method.

papers.title_en: APT: Feedback-Driven Agentic Post-Training for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.authors: Sirui Zhang, Fangyun Wei, Dong Chen, Jinjing Zhao, Yitong Wang, Yunuo Chen, Baining Guo, Zheng-Jun Zha
papers.evidence: 具有自适应提示词分布的自动化框架
papers.tldr: 本文提出了APT（Agentic Post-Training）框架，这是一个用于文本到图像生成的完全自动化且具备反馈驱动的后训练方法。该方法通过三个智能体协同工作，动态构建评估集、诊断模型优缺点并生成强化学习数据，形成类似递归自我改进的反馈循环，从而自适应地提升文生图模型的能力。
papers.abstract_en: Post-training is crucial for improving text-to-image models, yet existing pipelines typically rely on manually curated training data and fixed training distributions. We introduce APT (Agentic Post-Training), a fully automated framework that adaptively post-trains a base model according to its evolving capability profile. APT coordinates three agents to construct evaluation sets from user requirements, diagnose model-specific strengths and failure modes, and generate reinforcement learning data with an adaptive prompt distribution that emphasizes underperforming capabilities. By repeatedly evaluating, diagnosing, and updating the generator, APT lets the current model's behavior shape its next training tasks, forming a feedback loop inspired by recursive self-improvement. For general-purpose settings without user-specified evaluation scenarios, we further develop an evaluation harness that enables broad and diverse evaluation set generation. Experiments across multiple base models, benchmarks, and generation architectures demonstrate that APT is model-agnostic, benchmark-agnostic, architecture-agnostic, and fully automated.

papers.title_en: PACT: A Pragmatic Prompting Framework for Expressive and Voice-Preserving Speech-to-Speech Translation
papers.evidence: 将语用线索转换为语音生成的连续提示词
papers.tldr: 语音到语音翻译（S2ST）需在保持语义的同时保留说话者的音色和情感等表现力特征。现有系统在实现目标语言的情感、语调和节奏等方面存在不足。为此，本文提出了PACT框架，通过提取并映射源语语用线索为连续提示，驱动冻结的语音生成器。在西班牙语-英语评估中，PACT在内容保真度、音色与表现力保持方面均取得了最佳综合性能。
papers.abstract_en: Speech-to-speech translation should preserve not only what is said, but also who says it and how it is said. Existing end-to-end S2ST, speech MLLM, and cascade systems can preserve content or timbre, but often struggle to realize emotion, tone, rhythm, pauses, and pragmatic attitude in the target language. We propose PACT, a target-space pragmatic prompting framework for expressive and voice-preserving S2ST. PACT extracts source pragmatic cues, projects them into the target-language expression space, calibrates the projected representation to a realizable target subspace, and converts it into continuous prompts for a frozen speech generator. On bidirectional Spanish-English TOPI evaluation, PACT achieves the best overall performance among evaluated systems across content fidelity, voice preservation, and expression preservation metrics.

papers.authors: Yanxi Pan, Jingwen Wu, Yan Ma, Xiang Chen, Xinyi Zeng, Xuetong Wang, Yunyan Zhang, Yue Zhang, Yu Tian, Jianfeng Pan, Hongyi Zhou
papers.evidence: 通过查询自适应引导激发大语言模型能力
papers.tldr: 大语言模型在推理时难以适应多样化的知识和推理需求。为此，本文提出了Q-NeuS框架，通过动态调节神经元来实现查询自适应的内部干预。该方法无需修改基座模型，在多个基准测试中显著提升了模型性能，展现出强大的泛化能力。
papers.abstract_en: Effectively eliciting the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) at inference time remains an important challenge. Existing studies address this challenge through context engineering, which shapes user queries, or fixed steering, which directly intervenes in model computation. However, predefined contexts and fixed intervention strategies may not adequately accommodate the diverse knowledge and reasoning requirements of individual queries. This raises a natural question: Can internal steering in LLMs be made query-adaptive? In this work, we investigate whether query-induced internal activations can guide adaptive steering in LLMs. Our pilot studies reveal subject- and layer-dependent neuron activation patterns and show that amplifying subject-relevant neurons can improve model performance. Based on these findings, we propose Q-NeuS, a query-adaptive neuron steering framework that dynamically determines which neurons to modulate and by how much for each input. Specifically, Q-NeuS constructs a compact subject-guided candidate neuron space and employs a lightweight Query-Adaptive Gate to generate neuron-wise modulation coefficients. To learn effective intervention strategies, we introduce Neu-GRPO, which adapts group-relative optimization to train the Query-Adaptive Gate using the relative performance of multiple neuron intervention configurations. The base LLM remains frozen throughout training and inference, and no task or subject labels are required at inference time. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that Q-NeuS consistently improves model performance and exhibits broad applicability across model scales and strong cross-benchmark transferability.

papers.title_en: Online LLM Personalization from Pairwise Preferences Across Users
papers.authors: Romain Puech, Georgy Salakhutdinov, Dimitris Bertsimas
papers.evidence: 从固定提示词集中进行在线选择
papers.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型在推理阶段的在线个性化问题，旨在通过用户对成对响应的偏好选择，在不同用户和问题间动态匹配最佳提示词（即教学风格）。作者建立了包含多种教学风格和模拟学生偏好的教学基准数据集，并提出了一种利用历史会话学习用户混合先验、在当前会话中自适应调整的基线算法。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can answer the same question in different styles, but users' preferred styles are hidden and vary across users and questions. We study inference-time personalization through online selection from a fixed set of prompts, each representing a persona. Users arrive sequentially, each asks a short sequence of questions, and the system displays two responses per question and observes one pairwise choice. We formulate this interaction as a variant of the contextual dueling bandit problem in which the learner starts without preference data, adapts within each session, and exploits information shared across users. The objective is to minimize cumulative strong regret, summing the utility gaps of both displayed responses relative to the user's best response among the available options. We make two contributions. First, we introduce the problem and release a reproducible preference benchmark and dataset built around a tutoring case study, containing educational questions, LLM-generated answers in six teaching styles, and pairwise judgments from LLM-simulated students with hidden preference profiles. We fit Bradley-Terry models to these judgments to obtain reference utilities for regret evaluation. Second, we propose a baseline that learns a mixture prior over users from completed sessions and adapts to each new user within the session. On students and topics never used in development, it removes 44-48% of random pairs' excess regret and achieves over half the performance of a per-user linear oracle fitted in hindsight. We release code, prompts, and the benchmark.

papers.title_en: Reliable Text-to-SQL in Resource-Constrained Settings with Small LLMs via Iterative Retry Workflows
papers.evidence: 提示词表述如何影响小规模LLM的性能
papers.tldr: 本文探讨了在资源受限环境下利用小型开源大语言模型（1B-8B参数）实现可靠Text-to-SQL任务的方法。研究发现SQL专用模型在小规模下表现更稳定，而提示词选择对性能影响显著。为此，作者提出了三种轻量级迭代重试工作流，通过以少量的额外推理成本换取更高的成功率，为小型LLM在Text-to-SQL中的应用提供了切实可行的路径。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently improved Text-to-SQL generation, but their computational cost can hinder deployment in resource-constrained settings. This paper evaluates the Text-to-SQL capabilities of small and medium open-source LLMs (1B-8B parameters) under a controlled inference budget, focusing on how model specialization and prompt formulation affect performance. Using the Spider benchmark, we compare multiple prompt representations and assess the accuracy of generated queries. Our results show that SQL-specialized models are consistently more reliable than general-purpose and chat-oriented models at small scales, and that performance can vary substantially depending on the prompt used. To reduce this variability without resorting to larger models, we introduce three lightweight inference workflows that automatically retry with alternative prompts and/or models when failures occur, including an optional syntax-correction step. These workflows significantly improve end-to-end success rates, with a trade-off in additional inference calls. These results demonstrate a practical path to stronger Text-to-SQL performance with small LLMs, by trading modest additional inference cost for higher reliability.

papers.title_en: Confine to the Task, Anchor the Rest: Concept-Guided Retention Regularizer for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Ibna Kowsar, Ivan Medri, Fanyu Meng, Xin Liu
papers.evidence: 参数高效微调的正则化器
papers.tldr: 参数高效微调（PEFT）在适应新任务时往往会导致预训练知识的灾难性遗忘。本文提出了一种概念引导保留（CGR）正则化器，通过同时约束权重通道和激活通道，在不损失目标任务准确率的同时，显著提升了模型对预训练知识和通用概念的保持能力。
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has been widely used, yet the adapted model suffers catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained knowledge. While most existing work hardens the adapter by constraining where the weight update may lie, we note that constraining this weight channel does not constrain the activation channel. In this paper, we propose Concept-Guided Retention (CGR), a plug-and-play regularizer that constrains both for any PEFT base. CGR reads a frozen sparse autoencoder (SAE) and treats two disjoint concept sets differently. It softly confines the update to the task-concept subspace (via weight channel), and anchors a selected set of general-purpose concepts to the frozen model (via activation channel). We also provide anchor value bounds based on weight updates to understand how they interact, and show that both terms are necessary. On a CLIP vision panel, CGR significantly improves retention at comparable accuracy for every base, and the same pattern holds for world-knowledge retention under Llama-3.1-8B instruction tuning. Because the protected directions are named SAE concepts, CGR remains inspectable and controllable.

papers.title_en: VARI: Robust Text-to-Video Generation via Group-Structured Intent Alignment
papers.authors: Mingxuan Zhu, Hohei Chan, Shiyuan Liu, Yuanxing Zhang, Lu Chen
papers.evidence: 优化等效提示词表述之间的可靠性
papers.tldr: 现代文生视频模型对提示词措辞的变化高度敏感，语义实现和质量不稳定。为此，该论文提出了VARI框架，通过对同一视觉意图的多形式提示词进行群组结构化意图对齐与监督，在保持视频画质的同时，显著提升了模型跨提示词变体的鲁棒性与生成可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Modern text-to-video (T2V) models generate visually compelling videos, yet meaning-preserving changes in prompt wording can substantially alter semantic realization and overall quality. Existing prompt rewriting modifies the inference input, whereas conventional post-training constructs supervision from one prompt formulation at a time; neither explicitly optimizes reliability across equivalent forms. We introduce VARI (Verified Alignment over Representations of Intent), a group-structured framework that treats automatically verified formulations of the same visual intent as a shared supervision unit. VARI builds matched form-seed rollout pools, cross-scores each video against all forms, and applies a wording-independent structured intent audit to identify valid realizations and hard semantic failures. Group-Consistent Distillation (GCD) aligns every verified form with interchangeable valid realizations, while Form-Contrastive Flow-DPO (FC-DPO) learns group-level preferences from audited positive-negative pairs, prioritizing same-seed, different-form contrasts. On HunyuanVideo-1.5, VARI attains the highest T2V-CompBench, VBench, and StoryEval scores among the evaluated methods. On prompt-form extensions of T2V-CompBench and VBench, it improves weakest-form alignment over the strongest prompt-level baselines by 2.45 and 3.55 points and reduces cross-form drop by 30.5% and 32.2%, respectively, while preserving visual quality. Human evaluation, natural-caption controls, prompt-enhancement experiments, diversity analyses, and transfer to LTX-2.3 further support the robustness and transferability of these gains, while VARI requires no additional inference-time module.
